name: Moon Club
tagline: Learn the market like a game.

capture.command: make store-shots && rsync -a build/store-shots/iphone-69/ store/lobby/raw/iphone/ && rsync -a build/store-shots/ipad-13/ store/lobby/raw/ipad/
capture.notes: scripts/store-shots.sh drives the Store 69 / Store iPad 13 / Store Duo simulators. Raw files keep the NN-name.png names that shots[].raw refers to.

shots.title: Conquer the *market map*.
shots.sub: Win lands by reading candles, trends and patterns. A boss guards every flag.

shots.title: Build a candle with _your thumbs_.
shots.sub: Drag start, high, low and end. Suddenly charts make sense.

shots.title: Beat the *Captain's Quiz*.
shots.sub: Five questions, three hearts, one flag to plant.

shots.title: Grow a pile of *pretend coins*.
shots.sub: Follow real companies, learn why they move. Practice only, nothing real at stake.

shots.title: Today's *Market Story*.
shots.sub: Three tiny missions a day, written for kids.

shots.title: Why do prices *go up*?
shots.sub: Luna answers money questions in kid-sized words.

shots.title: Learn. Earn. *Launch rockets.*
shots.sub: Lessons earn Moon points, points unlock rockets. All just for fun.

shots.title: Collect them _all_.
shots.sub: Candle Reader, Trend Tracker, Boss Slayer, and more to chase.

feature.title: Learn the market *like a game*.
feature.sub: Candles, trends and boss quizzes for curious kids.
